candidate.name: file-type
candidate.engine: node >=22 (not used to infer browser compatibility)
candidate.browserCoreImport: No separate ./core export in 22.2.0; use package default export.

apng.recommendedComparisonMapping: image/apng -> image/png only for compatibility comparison; preserve original/source MIME and schema.

typeEvidence.strictNoNodeTypesCheck: TS2591 on node:stream/web and node:stream declarations when @types/node excluded and skipLibCheck=false; file-type API itself uses Uint8Array. Project has @types/node@22.20.5 and skipLibCheck=true; explicit node types check passes.

provenance: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/AVIF/APNG/animated WebP samples generated locally with Pillow 12.3.0 codecs. No public fixture copied; AVIF came from Pillow AVIF encoder, not canvas.
limitations: Magic signature recognition is best effort, not full decode, integrity validation, or safety proof.
Browser Image.decode is separately recorded; valid signature+IHDR PNG samples were recognized by file-type but rejected by Chromium decode.
MIME normalization test used trim/lowercase and removed semicolon parameters. image/pjpeg stays a distinct MIME and needs an explicit product decision; it is not silently aliased.
Bundle delta is candidate test entry relative to minimal Vite entry, not a guaranteed exact diff for Marklflow production chunk.
No production package.json/bun.lock/source changed by this experiment.
